_comment: Business settings — safe to edit from the GitHub web editor. Change a value, commit, done. If you make a typo the build fails and the LIVE SITE IS UNAFFECTED. See skills/ for step-by-step guides.

business.name: The Oven Vibe
business.tagline: Fresh, hot, oven-baked — made in Sundargarh

address._comment: 'street' must match the Google Business Profile address word-for-word. Carried over from the v1 site; verify it against GBP and fix it HERE (one place) if it differs.
address.street: Bijaya Talkies Road, In front of Subasini Clinic

hours._late_night_comment: Late-night (after 11:30 PM): ₹50 kitchen reopen per order, full advance payment, limited menu (mostly pizza, sandwiches, fries).

rating._comment: Keep these HONEST — copy the exact numbers from Google Business Profile. Never invent.

delivery.beyond_note: Beyond 6 km, order through Zomato or Swiggy — they cover the distance, we cook the food.

late_night.note: After closing we fire the oven again just for your order.
late_night.menu_note: Late night: no pasta or maggi — those stations are shut. Everything else is on.
late_night._availability_comment: What the kitchen STOPS cooking after closing (the boiling stations). Everything not listed here stays available. Categories cover future items automatically; unavailable_items is for one-offs inside a category that otherwise stays on.
late_night._charge_comment: One ₹50 kitchen reopen charge per late-night order, including pickup. Delivery uses the standard distance slab with no late-night premium.
late_night.advance_note: Full advance payment of the final total is required for every late-night order, including delivery, kitchen reopen and any active rain charge. Ask us for the payment QR before we prepare it.
late_night.advance_note_quote: Late-night order — I will pay the full final total in advance, including delivery, kitchen reopen and any active rain charge. Please send your payment QR.
late_night._advance_comment: All late-night orders require full payment of the final quoted total in advance; the owner verifies receipt before accepting the order.
late_night.pickup_note_quote: Late-night pickup — I will pay the full final total in advance. Please send your payment QR. I will collect it myself.
late_night.explain_note: The ₹50 kitchen reopen charge covers firing the oven again after closing. Collecting it yourself saves the ₹{ride} delivery charge.
late_night.explain_note_quote: I understand the ₹50 kitchen reopen charge applies once to this order.
late_night._explain_comment: The quote shows the standard delivery charge and one separate ₹50 kitchen reopen surge. Pickup has no delivery charge.

rain.note: Only while it is actually raining — we turn it off when it stops.
rain.prepaid_note: Pay the final quoted total online now to lock your price. Any active rain charge is included; no later rain charge will be added.
rain.later_note: If it rains when we ride out, ₹{surcharge} is added on delivery. Pay online now and your price is locked instead.
rain._comment: rain.active declares rain now. An active rain surcharge is included in the quoted total, including late-night orders. Pickup has no rain charge.
rain.later_note_quote: I will pay on delivery. I understand that if it rains when you ride out, ₹{surcharge} extra is added to my bill.
rain.prepaid_note_quote: I will pay the final quoted total online now, including any active rain charge, to lock the price against later rain charges. Please send your payment QR.
rain._note_voice_comment: later_note / prepaid_note speak TO the customer on the page. The _quote variants are written in the CUSTOMER's voice, because the customer is the one sending them: they land in the kitchen's WhatsApp as "please send your QR", "my bill", "when you ride out". Same facts, spoken by the person pressing send.

delivery._localities_comment: Delivery areas the kitchen serves, owner-supplied 2026-08-17. Feeds the admin panel's locality dropdown via /site.config.json. Keep alphabetical; any locality the owner types into the admin panel is saved in the database and appears in the dropdown automatically, so this list only needs the ones known up front.

regulars.note: Order three times and surcharges stop applying to you.
regulars._comment: Not offered on the public site: there is no system yet that tracks who is a regular, so a self-declared tick could not be verified. The kitchen applies this manually when it quotes. Re-expose it in the calculator and the FAQ once repeat customers are actually tracked.

delivery.radius_note: We deliver up to 6 km ourselves. Beyond 6 km, order through Zomato or Swiggy.
delivery.pickup_note_quote: I will collect this order myself from the kitchen and I will pay on delivery.
delivery._quote_voice_comment: Everything the customer SENDS is written in their own voice and reads as an acknowledgement ("I understand that...", "my bill"), so the message doubles as a record of what they agreed to. The notes shown ON the page stay in the site's voice - that is the website informing them, and it is deliberately left alone.

preorder.note: Pre-orders need at least {hours} hours’ notice — the kitchen has to prep and shop for it.
preorder.earliest_note: The earliest we can take a pre-order right now is {earliest}.
preorder._comment: A pre-order is an explicit choice, not a guess from the clock. Off = ordering now, and the date and time follow the clock. On = the customer picks a slot at least min_hours_ahead away; late night, closed hours and rain are judged at that slot.

announcement._comment: Set 'text' to show a banner on every page (e.g. 'Closed today for Holi 🎨'). Set it back to empty "" to hide.

analytics._comment: Paste your Umami website ID from cloud.umami.is → Settings → Websites. Leave "" to disable analytics.

backend._comment: The Cloudflare Worker (the-oven-vibe-backend) that stores orders and proxies the kitchen's ntfy alert. Not a secret — just a URL. Leave "" to disable order capture and alerts entirely.

push._comment: VAPID public key for push subscribe (Phase 3). Safe here — it's the public half of the pair. Leave "" to disable the soft-ask card entirely.
